title: Denmark – Construction work – EU udbud i forbindelse med totalentreprisekontrakt for opførelse af Vilhelmines Have Plejehjem
description: Nærværende EU-udbud vedrører en totalentreprisekontrakt for opførelse af Vilhelmines Have Plejehjem, herefter benævnet ’’Vilhelmines Have’’. Vilhelmines Have er beliggende i Koldings nordlige bydel i boligområdet Skovvejen-Skovparken. Forinden opførelse af Vilhelmines Have, skal tre boligblokke nedrives. Nedrivning er ikke en del af nærværende totalentreprisekontrakt. Lokalplan 0114-71 er gældende for området. Lokalplan 0114-71 er en opfølgning på den strategiske udviklingsplan for Skovvejen-Skovparken, der blev vedtaget af Byrådet i Kolding den 28. maj 2019. AAB Kolding er bygningsejer mens Kolding Kommune er kommende bruger og lejer af bygningen. Den daglige drift af bygningen varetages af AAB Kolding. Derfor er medlemmer fra både AAB Kolding og Kommunen en del af planlægningen samt udførelsen af projektet. Totalentreprisekontrakten udbydes af AAB Kolding, afdeling 04 og 08 v/ Bovia, som er den egentlige Bygherre og benævnes herefter ”Bygherre”, og kontrakten omfatter således både projektering og udførelse. Det er konkurrencens formål at frembringe forslag til opførelse af Vilhelmines Have, så projektet imødekommer ønsker vedrørende beboernes hverdagsliv samt de arkitektoniske krav, der fremgår af byggeprogrammet. I dette udbud er der følgende mindstekrav: - at levere 70 boliger med et samlet boligareal inkl. fællesboligareal på 4900 BBR m2 - at levere et serviceareal til plejehjemmet på 1750 BBR m2 Projektet vedrører almene boliger og gennemføres med offentlig støtte. Opgaven er underlagt den for sådanne sager gældende lovgivning med tilhørende cirkulærer og vejledninger. Totalentreprisen omfatter udarbejdelse af konkurrenceforslag, dispositionsforslag, udarbejdelse af forprojekt, myndighedsprojekt samt hovedprojekt og udførelsesprojekt. Totalentreprenøren er ansvarlig for alle projekterings-, rådgivnings- og udførelsesydelser samt myndighedsforhold, der er nødvendige for projektets gennemførelse i overensstemmelse md udbudsmaterialer, herunder projekteringsledelse, byggeledelse, fagtilsyn, opfølgning, IKT-ledelse og arbejdsmiljøkoordinering (P+B), samt certificerede rådgivere på brand og statik. ABT 18 med de ændringer og præciseringer, der fremgår af udbudsmaterialet, er gældende for totalentreprisen. Det udbudte arbejde er mere detaljeret beskrevet i udbudsmaterialet. Udbuddet gennemføres som en omvendt licitation med en fast maksimal entreprisesum på 120 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Fastpris: 120.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms Der konkurreres ikke på tilbudssummen for projektet. Evalueringen omfatter derimod de fastsatte kvalitative kriterier samt den økonomiske værdi af de fradrag, som tilbudsgiver måtte angive i Fradragslisten.

description: Experienced and qualified Companies are invited to provide a proposal for Condensate Polishing Package (Bechtel Goods and Services Code: MWDC) in accordance with quality requirements and EU Codes and Standards for the Poland Nuclear Power Plant. The scope of work shall include design, procurement, fabrication, skid mounting, shop testing, furnishing, and delivery of the Condensate Polishing Package that meets specifications, drawings, and other purchase order requirements. Delivery may be performed by either Bechtel or company, as determined by Bechtel. Interested companies must register/update their Company's information in Bechtel's iSupplier portal at https:// www.bechtel.com/supplier/. If Company has any questions or to express interest in bidding on this requirement, Company shall notify Bechtel’s Contact Person. At that point, Bechtel shall provide the interested party the Poland Prequalification Questionnaire where interested party would complete with response to Bechtel for review. Bechtel notes that previous proven capabilities and experience of similar scale and complexity will be mandatory and additional documentation/evidence may be required. The scope of work for this package consists of, but is not limited to, design, procurement, fabrication, skid mounting, shop testing, furnishing and delivery of the complete and fully operational equipment provided for each of 3 power plant units, including, but not limited to: pre-filters, condensate polisher vessels, cation & anion regenerations vessels, and other ancillary systems. Supplier shall be able to meet appropriate condensate polishing and resin regeneration equipment required to ensure 100% condensate polishing capacity (condensate flow rate 1194.25 kg/s; max. allowable pressure 44 barg) during normal power operation. NOTE: The quantities and dimensions provided above are APPROXIMATE only. The intent is to give bidders an idea of the scale of the project. Actual quantities and dimension numbers will be included in official bid package. Zakres prac dla tego pakietu obejmuje między innymi projektowanie, zakup materiałów i urządzeń, prefabrykację, montaż na ramach typu skid, próby warsztatowe, dostawę oraz przekazanie kompletnego i w pełni funkcjonalnego wyposażenia przewidzianego dla każdego z 3 bloków elektrowni, w tym między innymi: filtrów wstępnych, zbiorników układu oczyszczania kondensatu, zbiorników do regeneracji żywic kationitowych i anionitowych oraz innych systemów pomocniczych. Dostawca musi być w stanie zapewnić odpowiednie urządzenia do oczyszczania kondensatu oraz regeneracji żywic, wymagane do zapewnienia 100% wydajności oczyszczania kondensatu podczas normalnej pracy bloku (natężenie przepływu kondensatu: 1194,25 kg/s; maksymalne dopuszczalne ciśnienie: 44 barg). title: Netherlands – Accounting, auditing and fiscal services – (Heraanbesteding) Europese aanbesteding Fiscale adviesdiensten Gemeente Breda
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht De opdracht betreft een raamovereenkomst voor integrale fiscale adviesdiensten. De fiscale adviesdiensten hebben betrekking op alle mogelijke fiscale vraagstukken bij de gemeentelijke overheid of gelieerde overheidsbedrijven of deelnemingen, waaronder in ieder geval op het gebied van: - Vennootschapsbelasting; - Omzetbelasting (incuslief BTW compensatiefonds); - Loonbelasting; - Overdrachtsbelasting. Opdrachtgever heeft een fiscaal team binnen de organisatie welke voorziet in de fiscale advisering van de organisatie. Dit team heeft de fiscale (basis) kennis in huis en zorgt voor voorbereiding van aangiften. Het doel van deze raamovereenkomst is ondersteuning van het fiscaal team op het gebied van: - Indienen aangiften vennootschapsbelasting; - Uitvoeren van een jaarlijkse steekproefrapportage; - Natuurlijke adviesfunctie: sparringpartnerfunctie in (complexe) adviesvragen; - Back up in geval van te grote werkvoorraad. Jaarlijks wordt van opdrachtnemer gevraagd om in ieder geval de aangifte vennootschapsbelasting in te dienen. Voor het overige geeft de aanbestedende dienst geen omzetgarantie. Het daadwerkelijk benodigde fiscaal advies is voor een belangrijk deel afhankelijk van politieke, economische, maatschappelijke en interne ontwikkelingen. Voor de overige werkzaamheden zal voorafgaand aan de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden de inschrijver op verzoek van de gemeente een offerte/kostenraming indienen. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 240.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme - MRI Reporting Service
description:
The Contracting Authority is procuring a targeted prostate cancer screening pathway with a focus on men at increased risk due to an inherited BRCA2 variant utilising the competitive provider selection process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.

NHS England is seeking a provider to deliver a national centralised Prostate MRI Reporting Service to support the Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme for England.

The service will provide specialist reporting of prostate MRI examinations for Programme Participants requiring MRI following an above-threshold PSA result. The scope will include image receipt or access, case acceptance, specialist human double reporting, lesion delineation where required, expert arbitration, structured report production and authorisation, secure report return, acknowledgement and Failsafe arrangements, quality assurance, escalation, Programme data reporting, audit and governance participation.

Diagnostic MRI scanning is outside the scope of this procurement. The procurement also excludes PSA testing, biopsy delivery, urology treatment, BRCA digital decision-resource development, BRCA genetic testing and development of the national Programme IT system.

title: Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme – PSA Laboratory Processing Service
description:
The Contracting Authority is procuring a targeted prostate cancer screening pathway with a focus on men at increased risk due to an inherited BRCA2 variant utilising the competitive provider selection process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.

NHS England is seeking a provider to deliver a national Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) Laboratory Processing and Virtual Screening Pathway Coordination service to support the Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme for England.

The service will include PSA Sample logistics from the agreed collection handoff point, Sample receipt and accessioning, PSA processing and result authorisation, secure result transmission, consumables provision, Sample and pathway tracking, Failsafe management, Programme data and reporting, and Virtual Screening Pathway Coordination. The VSPC function will include coordination of MRI appointments following an above-threshold PSA result and coordination of biopsy/urology appointments following an actionable MRI result, within the Authority-approved pathway and responsibility arrangements.

The procurement does not include delivery of diagnostic MRI scanning or MRI reporting, biopsy procedures, urology treatment, BRCA digital decision-resource development, BRCA genetic testing or development of the national Programme IT system. Clinical delivery and acceptance of onward referrals remain with the relevant commissioned clinical providers.

title: Asbestos Abatement, Kejimkujik National Park and National Historic Site
description: 5P468-26-0262/A Asbestos Abatement, Kejimkujik National Park and National Historic Site BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808 (insert facsimile number). The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires the following procedures for the removal of asbestos containing vermiculite insulation from the attic of seven (7) employee housing units located in Caledonia, Nova Scotia. The housing units are for the staff employed at Keji National Park and National Historic Site. To assist with bonding and insurance requirements, this project is estimated at a value between $100,001 > $250,000, Taxes extra. TWO-SUBMISSION BID This Bid shall be submitted following a “two-submission” procedure. Refer to SI03 of the Special Instructions to Bidders. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than November 30, 2026. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT It is recommended that the Bidder or a representative of the Bidder visit the work site. Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at 17 Spruce Street, Caledonia, NS B0T 0A7 on Tuesday November 3 2026. The site visit will begin at 10:00am AST. Bidders must communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than 48 hours before the site visit to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders must also complete and submit a certification. Bidders who do not confirm attendance, provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend, or who do not complete and submit the above certification as required will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) calendar days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

title: Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) to Dredge Jetty NE at CFB Halifax, NS
description: DEFENCE CONSTRUCTION CANADA (DCC) – Project No. HX253262_87645 – HAL-Maint Former Jetty NE Site Dkyd, CFB Halifax, NS Defence Construction Canada (DCC) invites general contractors to express their interest in providing all labour, materials, and equipment necessary to undertake contaminated marine dredging and infrastructure rehabilitation at Jetty NE, CFB Halifax, NS This Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) is the first step of a two-step solicitation process, the second step being the Tender Phase.  Only general contractors that have expressed their interest through the Electronic Bidding System prior to the closing date and time of this RFEOI will be invited to submit a proposal at the second stage. Only submissions received in accordance with the requirements of the Electronic Bidding System will be considered. Only the general contractors who will have responded to this RFEOI will be invited to submit a bid during the Tender Phase. DCC reserves the right to terminate this solicitation at the end of the RFEOI. As part of Canada’s commitment to maximize the participation of Indigenous Businesses, bidders are advised that this solicitation includes an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP). The Contractor will have to include Indigenous businesses (or eligible joint ventures) as subcontractors or suppliers to this project. Further details will be provided in the Tender phase. This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA).   Project background A detailed project background can be reviewed in the Building Summary Documents Technical plans and specifications are not available during this RFEOI and will be provided during the Tender Phase; however, the Standard Construction Contract Documents for Electronic Bidding, DCL 250E, are available on DCC's website: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. Tenderers are advised that this contract is subject to DCC's Procurement Code of Conduct, which can be downloaded at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. A contractor or supplier who has been declared ineligible or suspended by Public Services and Procurement Canada under its Ineligibility and Suspension Policy and whose period of ineligibility or suspension may not have expired will not be able to proceed to the second stage. Bid security will be required during the Tender Phase in accordance with DCL193E- Instructions for Bidders for Electronic Bidding item 5. Estimate The Rough Order Magnitude estimate / Construction Cost Limit for this Contract is $26,834,000.00. This amount includes all construction costs, on-site work (including all required services, parking, and landscaping), site utilities, necessary redundant mechanical systems, communication conduits and wiring, backup power equipment, built-in equipment, built-in furniture, and inflation to achieve substantial completion. This amount excludes HST, design costs, travel and disbursements, consultant fees and expenses, movable equipment and furniture, IT equipment and contingencies. Schedule DCC will proceed with the Tender Phase around November 2026. The works shall reach substantial completion no later than 470 calendar days following the notification of contract award and shall be completed no later than 30 calendar days after the substantial completion date. Site visit No site visits will be offered during the RFEOI however, during the Tender Phase, bidders will be invited to a site visit. Access to information Act Tenderers are advised that DCC is subject to the provisions of the Access to Information Act (Canada). Information submitted may be eligible for disclosure in accordance with the requirements of the Act. Questions and clarifications Any questions or requests for clarification must be submitted in writing to DCC's Coordinator, Contract Services whose contact information can be found in the Electronic Bid System. DCC reserves the right to request clarification and/or confirmation regarding any aspect of this RFEOI to the Tenderer. In such a case, the Coordinator, Contract Services will be responsible for making the request. The request for clarification and/or confirmation will be sent to the contact person identified on the Electronic Submission System. Language of the Tender and the contract By submitting a response to this RFEOI, Tenderers will be invited to choose the desired official language for the tender documents and any resulting contract. In the Tender Phase, tender documents will be published in the language chosen by the Tenderer in the Electronic Bid System. Unless otherwise specified in the Contract, all Contract Documents to which the Contract applies or refers, as well as all deliverables, documents, reports and results of the work, services or goods that the Contractor submits, provides, or delivers to DCC or Canada in connection with the performance of the Contract, shall be in the language chosen by the Contractor on the Electronic Bid System. Joint venture A joint venture is an association of two or more parties that pools their funds, assets, knowledge, expertise, or other resources into a joint business venture, sometimes called a consortium, to bid together for a requirement. Tenderers submitting interest as a joint venture will be required to clearly indicate in the Electronic Submission System that they are forming a joint venture and should provide the following information: the name of the joint venture, if applicable, the name of the representative of the joint venture, i.e., the member chosen by the other members to represent them, if applicable, the name of each member of the joint venture. Security Requirements During Construction The Contractor will be required to hold, at all times during the performance of the construction contract, at least a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS) or Facility Security Clearance (FSC) issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada's (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). In the case of a joint venture, all parties to the joint venture must hold at least a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS). title: Ny cykel- og gangbro ved Sønder Havn
description: Med lokalplan 1119 er der skabt grundlag for etablering af en supplerende bro, parallelt og nord for den eksisterende blå klapbro i Søndre Havn, der både muliggør en ombygning af den eksisterende bro og forbedrer trafiksikkerheden for cyklister og gående. På den baggrund inviterer Køge Kommune (Ordregiver) til projektkonkurrence om udarbejdelse af et konceptuelt stærkt og realiserbart idéoplæg for en ny gang- og cykelbro. Konkurrencen omfatter – udover indgivelse af ovennævnte idéoplæg - afgivelse af tilbud på de efterfølgende rådgivningsydelser, herunder projektering, udarbejdelse af udbudsprojekt samt byggeledelse og fagtilsyn i forbindelse med realiseringen af projektet. Udbuddet forventes gennemført i følgende faser. 1) Gennemførelse af prækvalifikation med udvælgelse af 3-5 deltagere 2) Fremsendte tilbudte idéforslag, som en del af tilbuddet, vurderes af en bedømmelseskomité på baggrund af bedømmelseskriterierne 3) Mulighed for indledning af forhandling med vinderen af projektkonkurrencen på baggrund af estimater, timepriser, CV’ere, udkast til tidsplan, mv. som udgør en del af tilbuddet.

Hankittavien tuotteiden määrät ja tekniset vähimmäisvaatimukset on esitetty liitteenä olevassa valaisinluettelossa. Valaisimien tulee olla suoraan mekaanisesti ja sähköisesti yhteensopivia Kansallismuseon olemassa olevien ERCO 3-vaihevalokiskojen kanssa. Valaisimien runkomateriaalin tulee olla alumiinia. Valituksi tulevan toimittajan tulee pyrkiä toimittamaan Tavara mahdollisimman pian sopimuksen tekemisen jälkeen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan ennen määräaikaa. Tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan valitun toimittajan kanssa. Aikataulussa on huomioitava, että Tavaran toimitus tapahtuu museon avaamisprojektin aikana. Uudessa liitteessä "Kansallismuseo_näyttelyvalopaketti korjaus" lukuarvo on korjattu. description: This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, Joyceville Institution, Ontario Region. The Policy on Prioritizing Canadian Suppliers and Canadian Content in Strategic Federal Procurements applies to this bid solicitation. This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is open to both Indigenous and non-Indigenous businesses. All interested suppliers may participate. However, suppliers are to note that this requirement is subject to a preference for Indigenous suppliers and will be set-aside under the federal government Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB) if Canada receives two or more responsive bids from Indigenous businesses who meet the requirements of the PSIB. Indigenous businesses that have not already registered in the Indigenous Services Canada (ISC) Indigenous Business Directory should do so. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service Canada (CSC) has a requirement to replace the sidewalk between buildings JVJ25 & JVJ1 at Joyceville Institution. Deliverables: The Contractor must: a) Supply material, labour, and equipment to remove the existing sidewalk, and to install a new sidewalk between buildings JVJ25 to JVJ1. b) Remove and dispose of off-site the existing concrete sidewalk (approx. 2,000 ft2), including all associated debris. c) Excavate and prepare subgrade as required. d) Supply and install a compacted gravel sub-base suitable for sidewalk construction. e) Raise sub-base as necessary so that finished concrete surface is above adjacent sod/grade to prevent water pooling on new sidewalk. f) Install new concrete sidewalk with proper alignment and thickness. The report must detail all work completed and include photographs. Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: none. description: HANKINNAN TAUSTAA Koulutuskuntayhtymä OSAOn elintarvikealan koulutus siirtyy Haukiputaan toimipisteeseen osana tilojen uudistamista. Muutoksen yhteydessä rakennetaan ja varustellaan uudet elintarvikealan opetustilat, joihin hankitaan tarjouspyynnön mukaiset keittiölaitteet ja kalusteet. OSAO pyytää tarjouksia laitteista ja kalusteista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. HANKINNAN KOHDE Hankinnan kohteena ovat muun muassa : -keittopadat elintarviketilaan -RST-tasot, hyllyt, tekniikkaseinä -rasvapaistolaite leipomokäyttöön -vaihtolämpökaapit leipomokäyttöön -vesimittari leipomokäyttöön -pikapakastustunnelit elintarvikkeiden ja leipomotuotteiden jäähdytykseen ELINTARVIKEALAN OPETUSTILAT Elintarvikealan perustutkinnon opetusta annetaan kolmella osaamisalalla: elintarviketeknologia, liha-ala ja leipomoala. Elintarvikealan opiskelijat työllistyvät elintarviketeollisuuden työtehtäviin. Tilat toimivat tuotantokeittiöympäristönä, jossa valmistusprosessit ovat teollisen tuotannon kaltaisia ja käsiteltävät tuotantomäärät suuria. Tämän vuoksi laitteiden sijoittelun, mitoituksen ja yhteensopivuuden tulee mahdollistaa sujuva tuotantoprosessi. Tilakokonaisuus sisältää muun muassa seuraavat opetus- ja tuotantoalueet: -Liha- ja kalaosasto, jossa järjestetään liha- ja kala-alan opetusta sekä valmistetaan esimerkiksi makkaroita ja savustettuja tuotteita. -Konditoria- ja jäätelötila, jossa valmistetaan konditoriatuotteita sekä gelatoa. -Leipomo, jossa valmistetaan makeita ja suolaisia leipomotuotteita, kuten ruokaleipää. -Elintarviketilat, joissa suoritetaan elintarvikkeiden esikäsittelyä, valmistusta ja jatkojalostusta. Rakennettavissa opetustiloissa tapahtuu raaka-aineiden säilytys. Tuotantotiloissa tapahtuu raaka-aineiden esikäsittely, valmistus sekä kypsennys. Valmiit tuotteet jäähdytetään jäähdytystunneleissa, jonka jälkeen tuotteet pakataan ja siirretään välivarastoon. Välivarastosta on kuljetus myyntipaikkaan OSAOn Oppipuotiin. TOIMITUS- JA ASENNUSVASTUUT Haukiputaan toimipisteessä toteutetaan kiinteistön muutostyöt, joiden yhteydessä keittiötilat rakennetaan elintarvikealan opetuksen tarpeisiin. Vanhojen keittiölaitteiden ja koneiden purkamisesta sekä niiden uudelleenasennuksesta vastaa pääurakoitsija. Uusien tarjouspyynnön mukaisten laitteiden ja kalusteiden : keittopadat, vaihtolämpökaapit, rasvapaistolaite, pikapakastustunnelit, vesimittari, tekniikkaseinä, tasot, hyllyt ym. kalusteiden toimittamisesta ja asennuksesta vastaa laitetoimittaja yhteistyössä pääurakoitsijan kanssa. Kaikkien keittiölaitteiden ja koneiden lopullisista sähkö-, vesi-, viemäri- ja ilmanvaihtokytkennöistä vastaa pääurakoitsija. Pääurakoitsija vastaa keittiölaitteiden liitosjohdoista ja putkista. TOIMITUSAIKATAULU Toimitusten ja asennusten tulee tapahtua rakennusurakan aikataulun mukaisesti ja yhteistyössä tilaajan sekä pääurakoitsijan kanssa. Laitteet, kalusteet ja osissa toimitettavat pikapakastustunnelit tulee olla toimitettuna ja asennettuna viimeistään viikon 14 aikana, v. 2027. Tekniikkaseinä tulee olla toimitettuna ja asennettuna viimeistään viikolla 9, v.2027. Mikäli pikapakastustunnelit tulevat kokonaisena pakettina, tulee niiden toimitus ja asennus olla viimeistään viikolla 9, v.2027. Tarkemmat toimitusajankohdat sovitaan tilaajan kanssa erikseen. LAITTEIDEN MITOITUS JA YHTEENSOPIVUUS Kalusteiden ja laitteiden tulee vastata tarjouspyynnössä, piirustuksissa ja liiteasiakirjoissa esitettyjä vaatimuksia. Toimittaja vastaa tarjottujen laitteiden ja kalusteiden soveltuvuudesta sekä yhteensopivuudesta asennuspaikkaan. Tiloihin sijoitetaan sekä uusia että nykyisistä tiloista siirrettäviä laitteita ja kalusteita. Koska käytettävissä oleva tila on rajallinen, tarjottavien tuotteiden tule mahtua pohjapiirustuksessa ilmoitettuun paikkaan. Tarjouspyynnön liitteenä oleva Pohjapiirustus (liite 2) on viitteellinen suunnitelma. Osa-alueissa 1 ja 3 tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjouksensa liitteeksi oma keittiölaitesuunnitelma ja tekninen pohjapiirustus, jotka sisältävät kaikki tarjouspyynnön osa-alueissa hankittavat laitteet ja kalusteet. Suunnitelmassa tulee huomioida tilaajan olemassa olevat laitteet ja kalusteet. Suunnitelmissa uusien laitteiden ja kalusteiden tulee muodostaa olemassa olevien laitteiden ja kalusteiden kanssa toimiva ja tarkoituksenmukainen kokonaisuus. Pikapakastustunneleiden (osa-alue 2) osalta tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjouksensa liitteeksi erillinen suunnitelma ja tekninen pohjapiirustus, jossa esitetään mm. tunneleiden mitoitus ja sijoittelu. Näiden tulee olla yhteensopivat samaan tilaan tulevien kylmäsäilytystilojen kanssa, joiden rakentamisesta vastaa urakoitsija. Suunnitelman toimittamatta jättäminen johtaa tarjouksen hylkäämiseen tarjouspyynnön vastaisena. Pohjapiirustukset, kalusteluettelo ja muut tekniset tiedot ovat tarjouspyynnön liitteinä.
